channel.title: Euro-Office Community Edition testing (UnityStack GmbH)
channel.description: Updates of Euro-Office Community Edition for macOS, built and signed by UnityStack GmbH.

item.title: Euro-Office 9.3.8-ce.rc.1
item.description:
Community Edition by UnityStack GmbH, release candidate 1 of 9.3.8. It builds upstream Euro-Office v9.3.8; its changes are listed under v9.3.8 below.

Changes

  • Based on upstream Euro-Office v9.3.8.
  • Linux: the package build follows upstream's new RPM spec; offline help packages are no longer built (upstream's default).
  • Linux: the AppStream licence is now AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0, as in upstream's packages.
  • macOS: signing in CI accepts Apple's intermediate certificate when the runner already has it.

Built from f31a175, https://github.com/UnityStack/DesktopEditors/actions/runs/43850954827

item.title: Euro-Office 9.3.6-ce.rc.2
item.description:
Community Edition by UnityStack GmbH, release candidate 2.

Features

  • macOS: the DMG is signed with UnityStack's Developer ID and notarized by Apple, so it opens without a Gatekeeper warning.
  • macOS: automatic updates with Sparkle. Release candidates follow the testing feed, final releases the stable feed, both at https://packages.unitystack.eu/euro-office/macos/. rc.1 has no update feed: install this build once by hand.
  • Linux: signed apt, dnf and zypper repositories at https://packages.unitystack.eu/euro-office/, with the signing key at https://packages.unitystack.eu/keys/unitystack.asc. See build/linux/README.md for the setup.

Changes

  • macOS builds run on GitHub's macos-15 runners; the macos-14 images are retired.
  • macOS releases are built only for -ce tags.

Built from c3aec8c, https://github.com/UnityStack/DesktopEditors/actions/runs/43813221459
